A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables and complete Appendices A–G. Full-document text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching.

before.justification: V1 reports original experiments across nine datasets and five tasks, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, cross-domain evaluations and runtime measurements.

after.justification: V2 retains those empirical experiments and reports revised HHAR and cross-domain outcomes in Tables 2, 5, 9 and 11.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Appendix B retain the Fourier/Gabor transformations, encoders, instance-discrimination and mapping losses, training stages, and single-encoder-plus-mappers inference. No algorithmic or architectural change is documented.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same nine datasets for heart-rate estimation, activity recognition, step counting, cardiovascular disease classification and sleep staging. The cross-domain source/target scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including the supervised and SSL baselines in the main tables and the appendix comparisons with CBraMod, TimesURL and Finding Order in Chaos. Numerous baseline scores change, but methods are not added or removed.

E3.justification: Figure 4(b) changes the reported HHAR metric from F1 to accuracy. The stated splits, preprocessing, model configurations, training budgets and cross-domain procedures otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the metric revision involved rerunning experiments.

E4.justification: Evidence for the existing transformation and mapper ablations is revised for HHAR in Tables 5 and 9, and Table 11 revises transfer-generalization outcomes. Figure 4 retains the additional-view analysis but changes its HHAR metric. No new ablation component, robustness scenario or analytical question is introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over three seeded runs, five runs for timing, and the same Friedman/Nemenyi analysis in Appendix D.7. Changed standard-deviation values in the revised tables do not change these reporting practices.

E6.justification: Tables 2, 5, 9 and 11 substantially revise HHAR results: the proposed method's accuracy changes from 89.36±0.66 to 70.67±0.06. TS-TCC changes from 85.51 to 68.56 and TS2Vec from 86.13 to 67.13, reversing their accuracy ranking. Table 11 also revises cross-domain results for USC and Clemson; the proposed method's Clemson MAE changes from 2.13 to 2.40. Figure 4(b) replaces the HHAR results under its revised metric. The table protocols remain stated identically, but the reason for these numerical replacements is not explained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, propositions about unintended invariance and angular geometry, and their Appendix A proofs are unchanged. The Figure 4 metric revision introduces no new mathematical definition or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: augmentation-free learning through complementary frame projections, distinct latent geometries, lightweight mappers, and gains of up to 15–20% across nine datasets and five tasks.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning complementary geometry, transformation-induced bias, mapper benefits and cross-domain adaptation remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning theoretical explanations of performance, forecasting coverage and wavelet computation.

D1.justification: Section 3.3 and Appendices E–F retain the same architecture specifications, hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, hardware and computational disclosures. The source-code link and access statements are unchanged; no implementation explanation accompanies the revised results.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in Section 6 and Appendix G are unchanged. Correcting the spelling of Stéphane Mallat in reference 26 is a bibliographic correction, not a change in cited work.

P1.justification: Small edits correct 'were' to 'where' after Equation 2, remove 'in' from 'in for' in Table 1's caption, and correct Mallat's name. The arXiv version/date header changes, while paragraph organization and section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 4(b) receives revised HHAR axis ticks, point positions and a caption identifying accuracy instead of F1. Table 1's caption is corrected. The overall figure/table inventory, structures and placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Small wording fixes and some corrected table deltas are outweighed by newly inconsistent HHAR ablation reporting. In v1 Table 5, 86.50 is correctly marked as 2.09 below 88.59; v2 retains 86.50 (−2.09) while changing the reference to 68.79, reversing the numerical implication. V2 also labels 67.62 versus 67.74 as −1.12 instead of −0.12. These localized inconsistencies weaken the interpretability of the revised evidence, while the method, theory and most experiments remain unchanged.
